routingType.description: Call routing type to use to dispatch calls to agents.

policy.description: Call routing policy to use to dispatch calls to agents.

callBounceEnabled.description: If enabled, bounce calls after the set number of rings.

callBounceMaxRings.description: Number of rings after which to bounce call, if call bounce is enabled.

alertAgentEnabled.description: Alert agent if call on hold more than `alertAgentMaxSeconds`.

alertAgentMaxSeconds.description: Number of second after which to alert agent if `alertAgentEnabled.`

callBounceOnHoldEnabled.description: Bounce if call on hold more than `callBounceMaxSeconds`.

callBounceOnHoldMaxSeconds.description: Number of second after which to bounce if `callBounceEnabled`.

callBounce.description: Settings for when the call is not answered.

enabled.description: Whether or not the `distinctiveRing` is enabled.

ringPattern.description: Ring pattern for when this call queue is called. Only available when `distinctiveRing` is enabled for the call queue.

distinctiveRing.description: Whether or not the call queue has the `distinctiveRing` option enabled.
